notes.title: Patch 1.03 - Elite Enemies Ahead!
notes.content:
Ahoy Captains!

With Patch 1.03, we’re introducing several highly requested improvements to Endless Mode, which unlocks once you've completed the campaign.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992135/b8dd3ce6b35f4ca8d687abb1492d85b15bf13083.png
Skill Tree Now Accessible in Endless Mode

You can finally apply your Skill Points in Endless Mode without needing to return to Mouse Island!
Here’s how it works:

 Every 10th level gives you the opportunity to apply your Skill Points.
 You can track your progress toward the next Skill Tree location at the top of the screen.
 Your fleet and cash will remain intact until you lose all of your ships.

This update introduces a more rewarding progression loop and allows you to unlock all achievements without deliberately sacrificing your fleet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992135/8b6cd9328256a3e056b8f558bb9cd4ff94830eae.png
New Elite Enemies

Our enemies now have Elite versions - stronger, faster, and tougher - designed to offer the ultimate challenge in Endless Mode.
They await you once you've completed the campaign and are ready to set sail into the unknown!

We’ve also fixed some minor localization and UI bugs.

We hope you enjoy the update and look forward to hearing your feedback!

Best wishes,
Marie & Marc

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Ahoy Captains!

With Update 1.02, we’re addressing several minor bugs and issues, including the following:


Gamepad Steering Improvements: 
Previously, steering left and right was not a player-mappable keybinding for gamepads, as it relied on the 2D axis input provided only by a stick when the "screen-aligned steering" option was active. Now, we’ve added two additional gamepad buttons for steering left and right from the ship’s perspective (LB and RB by default). These can now be remapped just like the keyboard controls.
Skill Tree Fix: 
A bug that prevented skills from being selected using a gamepad or Steam Deck has been fixed.
Camera Shake Option: 
You can now disable camera shakes in the options menu.
Localization Fixes: 
We’ve corrected a few minor localization typos in the German translation.
Korean Localization: 
Korean language support is now available!


Thanks, everyone, for your invaluable feedback! Keep it coming!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.09
notes.content:
Aside from some text and localization improvements, we have made the following changes for the demo:


Ship-aligned steering can now also be used with a gamepad (previously only available for the keyboard). You can find this setting in the options menu and switch anytime to try out which steering works best for you.
As the demo starts during a run, the tutorial is now skipped, allowing players to freely explore the mechanics on their own.
The practice target no longer resets and is now properly destroyed like other enemies.

notes.title: Immediate Action & New Accessories
notes.content:
The demo now provides an insight into the naval battles right from the start, allowing players to quickly get an impression of the core gameplay. 

Additionally, we have added the following points to the demo:

- Optional camera lock
- Enemy intro shots
- More diverse crew accessories
- Various minor improvements to balancing and controls

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.07
notes.content:
In this patch we add some minor improvements:
- HP bars are segmentd now to visually represent HP differences.
- Ramming now doesn't damage your own ship anymore. Instead the skill increases your damage.
- Severeal localization improvements.
- Minor balancing adjustments.

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.06
notes.content:
In our todays Demo Patch we improve the following aspects of Fluffy Sailors:

- Otter Trader: Buy funny combat accessories for your Crew!
- Streamlined Gameflow: HUD Map to reduce time between combat levels
- Improved Controls: Interaction and leaving the level are triggered by the same button now
- Performance improvements: We massively improved performance for GPU and CPU
- Skilltree costs rework: Skills of the same tier now cost the same, for better replayability and build strategy
- AI improvements: Enemies sightranges now react to combat
- Several further bugfixes and visual improvements

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.05
notes.content:
In this larger patch we include:

- Improved visuals for UI, Vfx and Weather
- More intuitive skilltree with tier based progression
- Skillbased dashing and ramming, speed powerups got removed
- Enemy comments
- Further tuning and balancing for smoother combat experience

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
Aside from some small bug fixes, this update includes:
- A new, impoved way to steer your ship. Shooting can be done without holding aim before.
- Massively improved tutorial, ship steering should be a lot more clear now.
- Border fog fades in now, levels are larger.

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.02
notes.content:
In this patch we include the following improvements:

- The "Bullseye" skill got replaced by a new "Gunpawder" skill
- New iteration on the background music
- Captured ships are getting auto collected
- Small UI and localization fixes

notes.title: Pirats spottet!
notes.content:
The Pirats arrived!

Today our demo gets extended by a new enemy ship, the Pirats.
Rats might be weak on their own, but they like to attack as fleets, so watch out!
Furthermore, we adjusted the balancing for the other ships accordingly to make the learning curve less steep.
